_doc: Idle budget of cmux NEXT, schema v2 (scripts/cmux-next/idle-budget.py; plans/cmux-next/idle-wakeups.md section 9; numbers D2-D16 of plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p14-energy.md). Idle: no input, no visible change, terminals quiet, after the settle. A limit is a maximum; a string limit (role) must match. Per-kind fields: wakeups_per_s, cpu_pct, energy_mw_cpu, energy_mw_billed, gpu_ms_per_s, disk_bytes_per_s and log_lines are the sum over the kind's processes; wakeups_per_s counts interrupt wakeups only (Chrome's GetIdleWakeupsPerSecond, Activity Monitor; p14-energy-047, 2026-10-25: before 047 it was package-idle + interrupt, which counted every package-idle wakeup twice, so earlier numbers are not comparable); energy_mw_cpu is the process's own CPU energy (mW); energy_mw_billed is CPU energy + energy billed to the process - energy it serviced for others (mW); pkg_idle_wakeups_per_s is reported, not judged; energy_mw_cpu is judged only where a session names it (the light-webkit tree: D2's 'tree CPU energy <= 1.0 mW'); wakeups_max, hidden_wakeups_max (only the processes of hidden pages) and threads_max are per process; main_wakes_per_s is the app's main run loop; role is the process's Darwin role (foreground | napped | best-effort | background, read by task 106). Lookup order: sessions.<s>.kinds.<k>.<field>, then kinds.<k>.<field> (one number or {session: number}), then all_kinds.<field>, unless the kind is busy in the session: `busy: true` makes every kind busy (an agent at work), a list of kind patterns only those (stress: its animating Chromium and WebKit pages; its app, daemon, holder, terminal-host and acpmux keep the v1 defaults, as v1 judged them); a reference session (chrome-static) is all busy. sums: a selector ('tree' = every process; 'a+b' = the sum of those kinds) and its summed fields; a sum with an unknown part (a kind that ran with the field null or missing) is unknown and not judged (IDLE-BUDGET-NOT-JUDGED). relative: a ratio to another session of the same run; ratio_to_chrome: a session's selector against chrome-static's; both are judged once every session is measured, whatever the --sessions order, and a reference session that was not measured is reported, not judged. xbench: D6 on an xbench.py results.json (idle-budget.py --xbench): a max_ratio row is the browser's median / vs's median, a max row is absolute. allowed_periodic: the only owners a `wakeup-allow: periodic <owner>` escape may name (wakeup-audit.py: at most 6, period_s >= 15). assertions_allowed_when: the keep-awake settings (shipping default pluggedIn); every session runs with them off (idle-budget.py BASE_CONFIG), a pmset assertion held by a cmux pid is an over unless the session's own `settings` turn one on, and an effective value other than the session's is an over; sessions with busy true and reference sessions are not judged (D11). null: measured and reported, not judged yet (thread caps come from task 091's first measurement). v1 (2026-10-24, PL-idle with the Performance Lead): app main 0, app <= 1/s, daemon <= 1/s, holder 0. Agent sessions (p14-energy-103, D14): agent-harness is every process under an acpmux agent host, pooled entries included; agent-idle judges app+daemon+acpmux and reports the hidden chat's harness (hidden_wakeups_max) until p14-energy-117 sets it to 0; a session kind limit that is null with a `_<field>` reason prints IDLE-BUDGET-NOT-JUDGED with that reason; agent-working-visible and busy-hidden are busy, judged only on their own rows. v2 (2026-10-25, p14-energy-002, PL-idle with the Performance Lead): the v1 kinds stay the defaults; light-webkit keeps them and tightens to D2; light takes D4's Chromium limits; sessions, sums, ratios, xbench, allowed_periodic and assertions added; the light-webkit tree limit is CPU energy, as D2 says; stress keeps v1's kind defaults outside its busy Chromium and WebKit kinds. v2.1 (2026-10-26, p14-energy-104; its numbers are the plan's, task 104 and D4): every process of the app's tree has a kind (idle-budget.py kind, from the window's own `ps` rows and debug.webui census): terminal-job (a terminal host's or a holder's descendants: the person's shell and jobs, reported, never judged), agent-harness (an __agent-host's descendants), holder (`__holder` or the standalone cmux-holder), now-playing (the Now Playing stream: its watch shell and the mediaremote-adapter.pl perl adapter), app-tool (the app's one-shot gh, git, rg and cmux-diff-sidecar and what they run; reported), cef-storage, cef-audio and cef-helper beside the other cef-* kinds, crash-watcher (CrashWatcher's `zsh -f`), cua-helper (cmux Computer Use.app, found by its --owner-pid too), webkit-app-page (a WebContent pid of cmux's own pages and spares in debug.webui) and webkit-browser-tab (any other WebContent of the app); webkit-webcontent is a WebContent of a build with no debug.webui (unsplit, reported). A process no rule names is `other:<executable>` and an over (`kind other != classified`) in every session but a reference browser's. A process row is `hidden` when it runs only hidden pages (debug.webui: a hidden page, a spare, and in a tab session every browser tab but the shown one), which hidden_wakeups_max judges. Every cef-* kind is judged: task 104's cef-extension 0.1 per process and cef-network 0.2; the others against Chrome in tabs-static (ratio_to_chrome: cef-host vs browser and cef-gpu vs gpu, D4; cef-renderer vs renderer, the utility kinds vs utility, cef-helper vs other) and D4's hidden renderer 0.1 per process there; cef-gpu's absolute 1.0/s is D4's goal, reported (`goals`: IDLE-BUDGET-GOAL), not judged. crash-watcher and cua-helper 0 (task 104). Hidden WebKit pages, app or browser tab, 0.5 per process (D4, p14-energy-116). crashpad, now-playing and app-tool have no plan number yet: reported. Every other session runs signed out (it signs out a restored sign-in).
_doc_d15: D15 (p14-energy.md, task p14-energy-105, PL-idle with the Performance Lead 2026-10-26): after the settle, in every idle session, every kind writes 0 disk bytes (disk_bytes_per_s: the ri_diskio_byteswritten delta), 0 unified-log lines (log_lines: `log show` of the pid set, info and debug included) and 0 network bytes (network_bytes: nettop over the window, lo0 included) unless an allowed_periodic entry excuses it: an entry with `kind` and `metrics` (a list of disk_bytes_per_s, network_bytes, log_lines) excuses that kind's metric; with `remote` (host or host:port, matched whole) it excuses only network_bytes moved to that end, and the bytes to any other end must stay within the limit. all_kinds judges every measured kind under its own limits; busy and reference sessions take only their own. network_loopback_bytes, connections and WindowServer's wakeups (delta against a window with cmux hidden) are reported, not judged. A failed reader is unknown (IDLE-BUDGET-READER-FAILED, IDLE-BUDGET-NOT-JUDGED), never a pass.

agent-harness._hidden_wakeups_max: D14: 0 after the freeze. Reported with an IDLE-BUDGET-NOT-JUDGED line until p14-energy-117 freezes idle harnesses of hidden sessions; 117 owns setting it to 0 (design-result.json lists this file in its files and acceptance)

allowed_periodic.why: harvests crash and error reports written by other processes; NSBackgroundActivityScheduler runs it (tolerance 120 s), and a run reads the log files and crash reports only when a watched folder changed or a read stopped at its bound; the unified log, which has no change signal, on every run (p14-energy-066a)
GitHub has no push for the feed; task 066 stops it while no feed surface shows
PROTOCOL.md keepalive of the device hub, only on a socket silent both ways for the interval (any frame re-arms it), 10% leeway; a socket with traffic sends none
the local model relay's bearer expires with the Stack access token (10 min); one flexible prefer-early DemandTimer 90 s before exp, only while signed in with acpmux
